ptpTexts.title: Start building an outpost on Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Begin construction of an outpost on the surface of Kerbin by attaching two different vessels with a docking port or a claw to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: An outpost on the surface of Kerbin would give us a place to stuff all the scientists complaining that there is not an outpost on the surface of Kerbin. Get started on one.
ptpTexts.msg: Finally! Now we can sit down and enjoy a snack on Kerbin without chasing it across the room!

ptpTexts.title: Transfer any crew between vessels near Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Transfer any crew into any vessel from another mission in orbit of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: Crew that have been cooped up for too long start muttering about "space krakens" and other such nonsense. We want to make sure that doesn't happen around Kerbin.
ptpTexts.msg: A few snack breaks, some counseling, and these crew members will be good as new!

ptpTexts.title: Dock two vessels on or around Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Attach two different vessels together near Kerbin with a docking port or a claw to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: Docking on or around Kerbin is a stepping stone to building greater things. Plus, it's one of the few times when ramming things together is encouraged!
ptpTexts.msg: It's like a vessel handshake, with minimal shaking and no hands. Congratulations!

ptpTexts.title: Escape the influence of Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Fly a vessel out of the gravitational influence of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: Public opinion suggests that Kerbin is holding back our progress. The solution is obvious: fly as far from the public as possible.
ptpTexts.msg: Well, there goes half our operational budget. Good job!

ptpTexts.instr: Launch your first vessel off of the launchpad or the runway to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: We'd like to officially start off the space program with a bang! A very controlled bang, preferably.

ptpTexts.title: Fly by Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Fly a vessel anywhere nearby Kerbin to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: Today is your lucky day! Simply head to Kerbin and pass by it. Easy as pie. No risk at all! Now sign this waiver.
ptpTexts.msg: Talk about close encounters! Any closer and there'd be paperwork.

ptpTexts.flavor: It would be somewhat disconcerting if all of our missions to Kerbin were one-way trips. Bring one back to Kerbin.
ptpTexts.msg: A return trip from Kerbin?! Is this mission log right? Incredible!

ptpTexts.msg: Touchdown confirmed on Kerbin! Any crash you can walk away from counts as a landing.

ptpTexts.msg: Welcome back from Kerbin! Report to decontamination for a full and thorough debriefing.

ptpTexts.title: Achieve goal
ptpTexts.instr: Fly a vessel up and out of the atmosphere and accelerate parallel with the surface until you are in a stable orbit to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: We need to achieve a stable orbit around Kerbin. All you should need to do is throw yourself at the ground and miss.

ptpTexts.title: Orbit The Mun
ptpTexts.instr: Put your vessel into a stable orbit around The Mun to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: We'd like you to go to The Mun and stay there in a nice stable orbit. It isn't personal. It's science!
ptpTexts.msg: A stable orbit has been achieved! Mission control is still debating the best way to get you back home. You packed a toothbrush, right?

ptpTexts.title: Return to Kerbin from orbit.
ptpTexts.instr: Slow down a vessel in orbit and return it to the surface to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: You left enough fuel in the tanks to return from orbit, right? We want the deposit on those parts back!
ptpTexts.msg: Congratulations on a safe return from orbit! You can stop kissing the ground now.

ptpTexts.title: Return to Kerbin from orbit of The Mun.
ptpTexts.instr: Bring a vessel that was in a stable orbit of The Mun back to the surface of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: We can't just leave vessels in orbit of The Mun forever. Those things are expensive! Return one to Kerbin.
ptpTexts.msg: Our engineers are already repurposing parts of the vessel from The Mun for other missions! Good work!

ptpTexts.title: Rendezvous two vessels in orbit of Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Have two different vessels in orbit of Kerbin within visual range of each other and kill their relative velocity to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: We need to test out our rendezvous capabilities. Park two vessels next to each other around Kerbin. What could possibly go wrong?
ptpTexts.msg: Beautiful! Synchronized free-falling isn't nearly as daunting as it sounds!

ptpTexts.instr: Recover or transmit any science experiment data from Kerbin to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: Give us a quick crew report before launching. It's fine if any of the lights on the control panel are flashing, just give it a swift kick.

ptpTexts.title: Gather scientific data from The Mun
ptpTexts.instr: Recover or transmit any science experiment data from The Mun to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: Sometimes science throws a curveball and we need to ask the hard questions, and by we, we mean you. Head to The Mun.
ptpTexts.msg: Yes! There's enough data on The Mun here to keep all of us employed for a good long while.

ptpTexts.flavor: We need to perform a space walk in orbit of Kerbin. This time try to keep your helmet free of bodily fluids.
ptpTexts.msg: Exceptional work! Now get back into the vessel before this turns into a rescue mission.

ptpTexts.title: Go on an orbital spacewalk near The Mun
ptpTexts.instr: Have a kerbal go on EVA in orbit of The Mun to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: We need to perform a space walk in orbit. This time try to keep your helmet free of bodily fluids.
ptpTexts.msg: Exceptional work! Now get back into the vessel before this turns into a rescue mission.

ptpTexts.title: Splash down into the oceans of Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Splash a vessel down into an ocean of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: We don't want vessels near Kerbin to start running hot. Splash one into the ocean. We are pretty sure it isn't flammable.
ptpTexts.msg: It wasn't until after splashdown that the engineers reminded us that your seat cushions can also be used as flotation devices!

ptpTexts.title: Start building a station in orbit of Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Begin construction of a station in orbit of Kerbin by attaching two different vessels with a docking port or a claw to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: A station in orbit of Kerbin would give us a place to study the long-term effects of microgravity on board game playability. You may begin construction immediately.
ptpTexts.msg: Great work! A few more modules on this station and snack shortages near Kerbin will be a thing of the past.

ptpTexts.title: Walk on the surface of Kerbin
ptpTexts.instr: Have a kerbal walk on the surface of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
ptpTexts.flavor: Walking on the surface of Kerbin is the next logical step in space exploration. Tripping, falling, rolling, tumbling, or skidding also qualify.
ptpTexts.msg: That's one small step for Kerbin, one giant leap for our budget!

result.title: Launch our first vessel!
result.synopsis: We'd like to officially start off the space program with a bang! A very controlled bang, preferably.
result.description: At Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society, we need brave Kerbals with the right stuff to help achieve our dreams. Nobody has set any space records yet! It would probably be best to just start by getting something off the launchpad. Then we can start worrying about things like "survivability". But really, there's no sense in us still talking while there's science to be done. Shall we get to it?

result.description: At Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society, we need brave Kerbals with the right stuff to help achieve our dreams. We're trying to figure out if all matter in the universe is as dense as on Kerbin, but haven't come up with a conclusive test for it. But really, there's no sense in us still talking while there's science to be done. Shall we get to it?

params.title: Go on an orbital spacewalk near Kerbin
params.instr: Have a kerbal go on EVA in orbit of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to perform a space walk in orbit of Kerbin. This time try to keep your helmet free of bodily fluids.
params.msg: Exceptional work! Now get back into the vessel before this turns into a rescue mission.

result.description: At Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society, we're not afraid to try new things. As a result, we sometimes find ourselves in the situation of needing outside help to solve a problem. To test out some of our more advanced theories, we need more debris in low orbit. It's time for you to take another step in advancing the frontier.

params.title: Rendezvous two vessels in orbit of Kerbin
params.instr: Have two different vessels in orbit of Kerbin within visual range of each other and kill their relative velocity to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to test out our rendezvous capabilities. Park two vessels next to each other around Kerbin. What could possibly go wrong?
params.msg: Beautiful! Synchronized free-falling isn't nearly as daunting as it sounds!

result.title: Explore The Mun.
result.synopsis: In the grand scheme of things, we know very little about  The Mun. Let's see if we can explore it a bit further.
result.description: The CEO (and chief bottle washer) at Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society has stumbled on a problem. We still have unchecked items on our list of records to break and would like to change that. But really, there's no sense in us still talking while there's science to be done. Shall we get to it?

params.title: Gather scientific data from The Mun
params.instr: Recover or transmit any science experiment data from The Mun to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: Sometimes science throws a curveball and we need to ask the hard questions, and by we, we mean you. Head to The Mun.
params.msg: Yes! There's enough data on The Mun here to keep all of us employed for a good long while.

params.title: Return to Kerbin from orbit of The Mun.
params.instr: Bring a vessel that was in a stable orbit of The Mun back to the surface of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We can't just leave vessels in orbit of The Mun forever. Those things are expensive! Return one to Kerbin.
params.msg: Our engineers are already repurposing parts of the vessel from The Mun for other missions! Good work!

params.title: Return to Kerbin from a fly by of The Mun
params.instr: Bring a vessel that flew by The Mun back to the surface of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: It would be somewhat disconcerting if all of our missions to The Mun were one-way trips. Bring one back to Kerbin.
params.msg: A return trip from The Mun?! Is this mission log right? Incredible!

result.title: Explore Kerbin.
result.synopsis: In the grand scheme of things, we know very little about  Kerbin. Let's see if we can explore it a bit further.
result.description: The board of directors at Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society have raised some troubling issues. We believe that you are much better positioned to deal with this than us.

result.title: Explore The Mun.
result.synopsis: In the grand scheme of things, we know very little about  The Mun. Let's see if we can explore it a bit further.
result.description: As a consequence of a somewhat worse than average accident at Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society, we've been forced to look for some outside help. We want to know what shades of green we'll see if we expose a Kerbal to high gee forces. But really, there's no sense in us still talking while there's science to be done. Shall we get to it?

params.title: Go on an orbital spacewalk near The Mun
params.instr: Have a kerbal go on EVA in orbit of The Mun to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to perform a space walk in orbit. This time try to keep your helmet free of bodily fluids.
params.msg: Exceptional work! Now get back into the vessel before this turns into a rescue mission.

params.title: Transfer any crew between vessels near The Mun
params.instr: Transfer any crew into any vessel from another mission in orbit of The Mun to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: Crew that have been cooped up for too long start muttering about "space krakens" and other such nonsense. We want to make sure that doesn't happen around The Mun.
params.msg: A few snack breaks, some counseling, and these crew members will be good as new!

params.title: Gather scientific data from The Mun

params.flavor: Sometimes science throws a curveball and we need to ask the hard questions, and by we, we mean you. Head to The Mun.
params.msg: Yes! There's enough data on The Mun here to keep all of us employed for a good long while.

params.flavor: Crew that have been cooped up for too long start muttering about "space krakens" and other such nonsense. We want to make sure that doesn't happen around The Mun.
params.msg: A few snack breaks, some counseling, and these crew members will be good as new!

result.title: Explore The Mun.
result.synopsis: In the grand scheme of things, we know very little about  The Mun. Let's see if we can explore it a bit further.
result.description: While cleaning up after an unintended ignition, one of the overworked teams at Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society raised an interesting question. We want to know what shades of green we'll see if we expose a Kerbal to high gee forces. This is why we're here.

params.title: Go on an orbital spacewalk near The Mun
params.instr: Have a kerbal go on EVA in orbit of The Mun to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to perform a space walk in orbit. This time try to keep your helmet free of bodily fluids.
params.msg: Exceptional work! Now get back into the vessel before this turns into a rescue mission.

params.title: Rendezvous two vessels in orbit of The Mun
params.instr: Have two different vessels in orbit of The Mun within visual range of each other and kill their relative velocity to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to test out our rendezvous capabilities. Park two vessels next to each other around The Mun. What could possibly go wrong?
params.msg: Beautiful! Synchronized free-falling isn't nearly as daunting as it sounds!

params.title: Transfer any crew between vessels near The Mun

result.description: At Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society, we need brave Kerbals with the right stuff to help achieve our dreams. params.title: Gather scientific data from Minmus
params.instr: Recover or transmit any science experiment data from Minmus to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: Sometimes science throws a curveball and we need to ask the hard questions, and by we, we mean you. Head to Minmus.
params.msg: Yes! There's enough data on Minmus here to keep all of us employed for a good long while.

params.title: Return to Kerbin from a fly by of Minmus
params.instr: Bring a vessel that flew by Minmus back to the surface of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: It would be somewhat disconcerting if all of our missions to Minmus were one-way trips. Bring one back to Kerbin.
params.msg: A return trip from Minmus?! Is this mission log right? Incredible!

result.title: Explore The Mun.
result.synopsis: In the grand scheme of things, we know very little about  The Mun. Let's see if we can explore it a bit further.
result.description: At Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society, we need brave Kerbals with the right stuff to help achieve our dreams. We want to know what shades of green we'll see if we expose a Kerbal to high gee forces. So this is where you come in.

params.title: Go on an orbital spacewalk near The Mun
params.instr: Have a kerbal go on EVA in orbit of The Mun to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to perform a space walk in orbit. This time try to keep your helmet free of bodily fluids.
params.msg: Exceptional work! Now get back into the vessel before this turns into a rescue mission.

params.title: Rendezvous two vessels in orbit of The Mun
params.instr: Have two different vessels in orbit of The Mun within visual range of each other and kill their relative velocity to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to test out our rendezvous capabilities. Park two vessels next to each other around The Mun. What could possibly go wrong?
params.msg: Beautiful! Synchronized free-falling isn't nearly as daunting as it sounds!

params.title: Return to Kerbin from orbit of The Mun.
params.instr: Bring a vessel that was in a stable orbit of The Mun back to the surface of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We can't just leave vessels in orbit of The Mun forever. Those things are expensive! Return one to Kerbin.
params.msg: Our engineers are already repurposing parts of the vessel from The Mun for other missions! Good work!

params.msg: A stable orbit has been achieved! Mission control is still debating the best way to get you back home. You packed a toothbrush, right?

params.title: Go on an orbital spacewalk near Jool
params.instr: Have a kerbal go on EVA in orbit of Jool to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to perform a space walk in orbit. This time try to keep your helmet free of bodily fluids.
params.msg: Exceptional work! Now get back into the vessel before this turns into a rescue mission.

params.title: Return to Kerbin from orbit of Jool.
params.instr: Bring a vessel that was in a stable orbit of Jool back to the surface of Kerbin to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We can't just leave vessels in orbit of Jool forever. Those things are expensive! Return one to Kerbin.
params.msg: Our engineers are already repurposing parts of the vessel from Jool for other missions! Good work!

result.title: Explore Jool.
result.synopsis: In the grand scheme of things, we know very little about  Jool. Let's see if we can explore it a bit further.
result.description: As a consequence of a somewhat worse than average accident at Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society, we've been forced to look for some outside help. We want to know what shades of green we'll see if we expose a Kerbal to high gee forces. But really, there's no sense in us still talking while there's science to be done. Shall we get to it?

result.description: The CEO (and chief bottle washer) at Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society has stumbled on a problem. We still have unchecked items on our list of records to break and would like to change that. So this is where you come in.

params.title: Gather scientific data from Eve
params.instr: Recover or transmit any science experiment data from Eve to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: Sometimes science throws a curveball and we need to ask the hard questions, and by we, we mean you. Head to Eve.
params.msg: Yes! There's enough data on Eve here to keep all of us employed for a good long while.

result.title: Explore Kerbin.
result.synopsis: Our exploration of Kerbin is going according to plan. We must continue to unravel its mysteries!
result.description: At Kerbin World-Firsts Record-Keeping Society, we need brave Kerbals with the right stuff to help achieve our dreams. To test out some of our more advanced theories, we need more debris in low orbit. We believe that you are much better positioned to deal with this than us.

params.title: Rendezvous two vessels in orbit of Kerbin
params.instr: Have two different vessels in orbit of Kerbin within visual range of each other and kill their relative velocity to achieve this goal.
params.flavor: We need to test out our rendezvous capabilities. Park two vessels next to each other around Kerbin. What could possibly go wrong?
params.msg: Beautiful! Synchronized free-falling isn't nearly as daunting as it sounds!
